partner.description: A stable key for the partner: the partner report's file names start with it

name.description: The partner's public name, as its project publishes it; never a person

link.description: The partner's own public link, shown with its seal (Sprint 10; a sponsor's, Sprint 15)

seal.description: The partner's seal, an image file the site serves (Sprint 10; a sponsor's, Sprint 15)

opensAt.description: The campaign's opens_at: with the id, it names one opening of the address

highlightFrom.description: When its highlight starts, Unix seconds UTC

highlightUntil.description: When its highlight ends (excluded), at most 72 hours after it starts

campaigns.description: The partner's campaigns, each opened by a team key (P-3); empty for a sponsor with no campaign

title: content/partners.json (Brot Markets)
description: Generated from packages/sdk/src/schemas/partners.ts by scripts/check-content-schema.ts --write; the zod schema is the check (it also refuses personal data in a name, a partner key or a campaign listed twice, and a highlight longer than 72 hours).
